ranking_by: days in space on a single mission
title: The 5 Longest Single Spaceflights Ever, Ranked (#1 Was Set in 1995)

scenes.text: The five longest single spaceflights ever, ranked. Number one has stood for thirty years.

scenes.label: Titov and Manarov · 366 days
scenes.text: Number five: Vladimir Titov and Musa Manarov. 366 days on the Mir station in 1988, the first people to pass a full year.

scenes.label: Frank Rubio · 371 days
scenes.text: Number four: Frank Rubio. 371 days in 2023, after his ride home sprang a leak. The longest American spaceflight ever.

scenes.label: Kononenko and Chub · 374 days
scenes.text: Number three: Oleg Kononenko and Nikolai Chub. 374 days in 2024. Kononenko's career total is 1,111 days, the most of anyone.

scenes.label: Sergei Avdeyev · 380 days
scenes.text: Number two: Sergei Avdeyev. 380 days on Mir, from 1998 to 1999.

scenes.label: Valeri Polyakov · 437 days
scenes.text: Number one: Valeri Polyakov. 437 days on Mir, landing in March 1995. A doctor, out to prove the body could take it. He refused the stretcher and walked.

description:
The five longest single spaceflights in history, ranked by days in orbit on one mission.
The record, 437 days by Valeri Polyakov on Mir in 1994 to 1995, has stood for three decades. Frank Rubio's 371 days in 2023 is the longest by an American.
How long could you stand being in orbit?
first_comment: Which of these would you have put at number one, and how long do you think you could last in orbit? Tell us what to rank next.
